name: MiniMax
short: MiniMax M-series platform; pay-as-you-go $0.15/$0.60 per 1M (M3.1-Flash) and $0.30/$1.20 (M3, permanent 50% off list), with Audio/Video resource packages and Code/Token plan lanes.

plans.name: MiniMax platform pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash: $0.15 in / $0.60 out / $0.015 cache read per 1M. MiniMax-M3 (permanent 50% off): <=512K input $0.30/$1.20 (cache $0.06, list $0.60/$2.40); >512K input $0.60/$2.40 (list $1.20/$4.80). Priority service tier = 1.5x standard. M2.5/M2.7 are no longer on the public LLM price table.

plans.name: Audio & Video packages
plans.notes: Audio packages (Starter $5 to Business $999/mo) cover all speech models via T2A v2/T2A large v2. Video packages ($1,000-$6,000/mo) cover Hailuo video models only - MiniMax H3 is PAYG-only. Unused video points expire with the package. Music generation APIs closed to new users since 2026-08-20.
